stem: What is the central idea of the selection?

options.label: A
options.text: Oceans are in trouble because sea life is disappearing.

options.label: B
options.text: Sylvia Earle is a scientist who loves studying all ocean life.

options.label: C
options.text: The group Mission Blue works in different ways to care for oceans.

options.label: D
options.text: The group Mission Blue wants to save the plants in the oceans.
